description: How often an employer writes its job ads in English, Finnish and Swedish, and how often those ads require Finnish or Swedish, each as a count over a total. Fits "can I work at this company without Finnish". Takes a companyId from a search result. Returns nothing for staffing agencies or employers with too few ads. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
